Description: Non-UK record cross-references (conventions, bodies, intl policies, EU legislation). Bracketed codes.
Short form / acronym, split out from Name (Name now holds full title only).

All cross-reference codes must be wrapped in square brackets — [LEG-NNN], [ORG-NNN], [POL-NNN], [INT-L/INT-O/INT-P-NNN], [EU-L-NNN] and [IFW-NN] — wherever they appear in a cell, regardless of any surrounding text. Codes are the join keys used by check_links.py; unbracketed codes are invisible to integrity checking.
Controlled_Vocabulary: Square brackets mandatory. Sole exception: the Record_ID / Framework_ID primary-key columns, which are never bracketed.

Description: DERIVED SHEET - do not edit by hand. One row per record, copied from the sheet the record lives on (Record_ID, Name, Acronym where the source sheet has one, Record_Type, General_Type, Policy_Sector, Extent where applicable) plus the source sheet name. Regenerated in source order by Data/code/rebuild_xref.py, which finalise.py runs as step 1 of 4 before the integrity check, so any manual edit is overwritten at the next run. Nothing reads this sheet: it is a human convenience index, which is why it drifted unnoticed between the 2026 vocabulary migration and v25.
